classification: source-conditional passable-plan versus rebound inferred-road geometry disagreement; no current dataset occurrence or run
title: Inferred roads replace snapped planner endpoints without admitting new end segments
earliest_failed_contract: A passability result belongs to the actual searched grid path, including snapped endpoints. enrich replaces those coordinates with original node coordinates then retains the old passable-alignment justification without searching/admitting replacement connector segments.
counterexample: Conditional admitted source window: original settlement node a maps to noncrossing Water; nearby grid cell s within snap radius8 is passable, with a land path s to goal t. Actual snap scans and selects passable s, so terrain.plan(a,b) can succeed on s→t even though a itself is not passable. enrich copies returned points then writes geometry[0]=a and geometry[last]=b. The new a→next point begins in unsearched impassable Water, but a Land route with no bridge/water_crossings and text claiming passable alignment between original nodes is published. The caller only checks finite typed points, counts, distance and time. Source branch witness, no initialized-world water settlement or generated-route run claimed.
actual_recipient: 2152 append_inferred_roads later copies accepted edge.geometry into canonical routing_roads.2153 uses those coordinates for both road mask and vector package.2079 terrain builder marks any road-over-water as crossing. Thus changed geometry can receive actual inferred-road/crossing authority after only the original snapped path was searched.
qualification: Do not claim all snap offsets are wrong: valid connected endpoint projection policy may be intentional, but its connector passability must be established or represented as distinct approximation. Actual world-node placement on water and dataset occurrence remain unverified. Generic512-point simplification turn loss is not the normal inferred-road explanation: minimum kernel30m and accepted distance<=12km bound the accepted original path to<=400 steps; retained turns<=401<512. Root M36/M52 and F42/F43 are different quantities/admission/cache issues.
connected_repair: Retain actual snapped endpoints and admit/trace connector segments to original nodes under explicit passage policy before authorizing an inferred Land link. Derive passability/provenance from the actual final geometry, with crossing/bridge distinctions when required; do not reuse a searched-path claim after arbitrary coordinate replacement.
acceptance: When a node projects to impassable terrain and snap finds nearby land, the final inferred connector either has explicit supported passable/crossing treatment or is rejected; resulting road-mask/vector geometry and provenance reference the same admitted final path. Land-only valid endpoint alignment and deterministic ordering remain unchanged. No new tests/data/build executed.
